'''Bazuka Soldier '''is an enemy in [[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|''Ninja Gaiden (NES)'']]''. 

=='''[[Ninja Gaiden (NES)|Ninja Gaiden]]'''== 
[[File:BazukaSoldierNES1.png|80px]]

First appearing in [[Lizard Mountain|Act 3-2,]] Bazuka Soldiers act as stationary turrets. After one second, they will fire a big rocket that travels forward, and will continue firing in the same interval. Their contact only does 1 damage, but their rocket does 2 damage. Still, they are easily destroyed in one hit, and sub-weapons like the Windmill Star and Spin Slash will best penetrate through their projectiles.
